name: Arcane Eye
description: An invisible magical eye hovers into being and reports everything it sees to you. As a bonus action you drift it up to 30 feet in any direction; its darkvision peers 30 feet in every direction, though solid barriers block it.

name: Aura of Life
description: A preserving radiance surrounds you in a 30-foot emanation: allies within resist necrotic damage, their hit point maximums cannot be reduced, and any ally who starts a turn at 0 hit points rises with 1 instead.

name: Aura of Purity
description: A cleansing aura extends 30 feet around you. Allies within resist poison damage and roll with advantage against effects that would blind, charm, deafen, frighten, paralyze, poison, or stun them.

name: Banishment
description: You hurl a creature to a harmless demiplane on a failed Charisma save, where it sits incapacitated until the spell ends. A creature native to another plane is sent home for good if you hold the spell the full minute; higher slots banish additional targets.

name: Blight
description: Necromantic energy withers a creature from within: it makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success. Plant creatures and vegetation gain no such mercy — they save at disadvantage and take maximum damage.

name: Compulsion
description: Creatures of your choice that can hear you and fail a Wisdom save become puppets of your direction: each turn you designate a direction with a bonus action, and they must spend as much of their movement as possible marching that way, saving again after each march. Only an obviously deadly hazard gives them pause.

name: Confusion
description: Minds unravel in a 10-foot sphere: creatures that fail a Wisdom save cannot take bonus actions or reactions and roll each turn to see whether they babble, wander, or attack at random. The save repeats at the end of each turn, and higher slots widen the sphere.

name: Conjure Minor Elementals
description: Elemental spirits swirl around you in a 15-foot emanation that is difficult terrain for your enemies. Every attack you land on a creature inside it deals an extra 2d8 damage — acid, cold, fire, or lightning, chosen with each blow. (Upcast scaling uses the current errata value.)

name: Conjure Woodland Beings
description: Nature spirits dance around you in a 10-foot emanation. A creature that enters it or ends its turn there makes a Wisdom save or takes 5d8 force damage, and while the spirits surround you, you can Disengage as a bonus action.

name: Control Water
description: All freestanding water in a cube up to 100 feet on a side obeys you: raise a flood or a traveling wave, part it into a trench, redirect its flow uphill, or spin a ship-smashing whirlpool (a creature caught in the vortex makes a Strength save, taking 2d8 bludgeoning damage on a failure), changing the effect as an action on your turns.

name: Death Ward
description: You ward a creature against death itself: the first time it would drop to 0 hit points, it drops to 1 instead and the spell ends. Instant-death effects are likewise turned aside, once.

name: Dimension Door
description: A word teleports you — and one willing creature your size or smaller — up to 500 feet to a place you picture or describe. Arrive in an occupied space and you both take 4d6 force damage and the jump fails, so choose wisely.

name: Divination
description: Your magic offers a gift to a god of knowledge, and in return you receive a truthful reply to one question about an event within the next seven days. The answer accounts for what is known, not for spells or surprises yet to come.

name: Dominate Beast
description: A beast that fails a Wisdom save is charmed and bound to your telepathic commands, fighting for you with advantage on its save if you or your companions are already battling it. Higher slots stretch your dominion to minutes or an hour.

name: Fabricate
description: Raw materials reshape themselves at your command — timber into a bridge, flax into rope or cloth, stone and metal into finished goods. Crafting anything intricate demands the artisan's proficiency to match.

name: Fire Shield
damage: 2d8 fire or cold (warm or chill shield)
description: Wispy flames wreath your body, shedding light: choose a warm shield that resists cold or a chill shield that resists fire. Either way, a creature that hits you with a melee attack within 5 feet is seared for 2d8 damage of the shield's element.

name: Freedom of Movement
description: A willing creature you touch slips every bond for an hour: terrain, spells, and grapples cannot slow or restrain it, and it can even spend 5 feet of movement to escape nonmagical restraints outright. Higher slots free additional creatures.

name: Giant Insect
description: You summon a giant centipede, spider, or wasp using the Giant Insect stat block, which scales with the slot you spend. It shares your initiative, obeys your verbal commands, and fights beside you until it drops or the spell ends.

name: Grasping Vine
description: A vine erupts from the ground and lashes out with your spell attack: on a hit it deals 4d8 bludgeoning damage, drags the target up to 30 feet toward it, and grapples it if it is Huge or smaller. As a bonus action on later turns you can strike again.

name: Greater Invisibility
description: You or a creature you touch vanishes from sight — gear and all — for the duration, and unlike lesser invisibility, attacking or casting does not reveal the hidden one.

name: Guardian of Faith
description: A Large spectral guardian bearing your god's emblem hovers in place for up to eight hours. Any enemy that moves within 10 feet of it or starts its turn there makes a Dexterity save, taking 20 radiant damage on a failure or half on a success — and after dealing 60 damage in all, the guardian's duty is done.

name: Hallucinatory Terrain
description: Natural terrain in a 150-foot cube is dressed in illusion — meadow over swamp, gentle slope over precipice — with look, sound, and smell to match, though touch betrays the truth and structures and creatures keep their forms.

name: Ice Storm
description: Hailstones pound down in a 20-foot-wide, 40-foot-tall cylinder: each creature in it makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d10 bludgeoning and 4d6 cold damage on a failure or half on a success. The ground is left difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.

name: Leomund's Secret Chest
description: An ornate chest vanishes into the Ethereal Plane, and with its miniature replica you can recall it — contents and all — whenever you wish, or banish it again as an action. Lose the replica, and your treasures are stranded beyond reach.

name: Locate Creature
description: Name a creature you know, or the nearest of a kind you have seen up close, and the spell points you toward it while it is within 1,000 feet — including which way it is moving. Running water at least 10 feet wide blocks the trail cold.

name: Mordenkainen's Faithful Hound
description: An invisible, phantom watchdog takes up guard duty for eight hours, barking loudly at strangers who approach and biting intruders you have not welcomed — each must succeed on a Dexterity save or take 4d8 force damage — though only you can see it.

name: Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum
description: You secure a cube up to 100 feet on a side with your choice of wards: sound cannot cross its edge, sight through it is dark fog, divination sensors are barred, creatures cannot teleport or plane-shift in or out, or the whole area is simply sealed against entry. Cast daily for a year in the same place, it becomes permanent.

name: Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
description: A shimmering sphere of force engulfs a Large or smaller creature that fails a Dexterity save: nothing passes in or out, the prisoner can take no damage, and the weightless globe can be rolled along — a perfect cage or a perfect shield.

name: Phantasmal Killer
description: You conjure a creature's deepest fear into its mind alone: on a failed Wisdom save it takes 4d10 psychic damage and reels with disadvantage on attacks and checks, saving again at the end of each turn — taking the damage once more on a failure, or half damage and freedom on a success.

name: Polymorph
description: You rewrite a creature's form into that of a beast no mightier than the target itself — an unwilling target resists with a Wisdom save. The new shape's hit points become temporary hit points over the old form, and when they are gone, so is the beast.

name: Staggering Smite
description: Cast as your weapon connects, the blow lands with concussive psychic force: the target takes an extra 4d6 psychic damage and must make a Wisdom save or reel — disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks, and no reactions — until the end of its next turn.

name: Stone Shape
description: Stone flows under your touch: a section no more than 5 feet in any dimension becomes a door, a passage, a rough sculpture, or whatever form you mold from it — hinges and latches included, if your craftsmanship allows.

name: Stoneskin
description: A willing creature's skin hardens to stone at the cost of diamond dust the spell consumes, granting resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage for the duration.

name: Wall of Fire
description: A wall of roaring flame springs up — 60 feet long in a line or a 20-foot ring — opaque and searing on one side of your choosing. Creatures on the hot side when it appears, or that enter it or end their turn within 10 feet of it, make a Dexterity save or take 5d8 fire damage, half on a success.
